text: Two terrorists killed, three injured in an intelligence-based operation in Balochistan’s Kilizak area. Security forces also recovered ammunition, hand grenades and IED-making materials.#Balochistan#SecurityForces#CounterTerrorism#Pakistan#PakistanTV

text: #BREAKINGAfghan United Front commander Gen Sami Sadat says the group has carried out 18 operations across six Afghan provinces in the past 15 days, vowing to expand attacks against the Taliban and calling for international political and material support.#Afghanistan#Taliban

text: NPR News Editor Mujeeb Ur Rehman says the Makkah Joint Defence Agreement is a major positive development for the United States, as it brings three key American security allies — Pakistan, Saudi Arabia and Turkiye — into a single regional security framework.#MakkahAgreement
translated_text: NPR 新闻编辑 Mujeeb Ur Rehman 表示，《麦加联合防御协议》对美国来说是一项重大的积极进展，因为它将美国的三个主要安全盟友——巴基斯坦、沙特阿拉伯和土耳其——纳入了一个单一的地区安全框架。#MakkahAgreement

text: Damage assessments and clean up efforts began Sunday as Hurricane Lala, which was downgraded to a tropical storm overnight, rolled past Hawaii's Big Island and kept dumping heavy rain across the US Pacific state's archipelago.#Hawaii#HurricaneLala#TropicalStorm#StormRecovery
